crossRefs.note: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from…
I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In…
But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of…
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years: until all…
To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire…
For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden…
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

translations.web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
translations.bsb: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
translations.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
translations.asv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.
